name: nrgs32b_mine_orderdiff_pypy
command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p logs/nrgs && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True python scripts/diff/mine_nrgs_prefix.py --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --variant order_diff --datatypes str int "list[int]" --n-per-pivot 4 --src-lang python --dst-lang python |& tee logs/nrgs/nrgs32b_mine_orderdiff_pypy.log

name: nrgs32b_train_orderdiff_pypy_default
command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p logs/nrgs && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True python scripts/diff/train_nrgs_mask.py --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --variant order_diff --src-lang python --dst-lang python |& tee logs/nrgs/nrgs32b_train_orderdiff_pypy_default.log
